security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' data: blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Blur sensitive text in any screenshot. Free, offline.
bundle.longDescription: Press the hotkey, drag over the part of the screen you want, and the screenshot with its sensitive text masked is on your clipboard. Everything runs on this computer; nothing is sent or stored.
